_comment: How badly the next release wants to be installed, set before the tag is
pushed. The version is named so the setting cannot outlive the release it
was written for: a hotfix left here would otherwise make the next
ordinary release install itself on every machine without asking.
normal     - features and ordinary fixes. Offered.
important  - worth going out of your way for. Offered, and said louder.
critical   - loses data or lets somebody in. Installed without asking,
on copies that can replace themselves and only when the
unsafeBelow narrows a critical release to the versions actually exposed.
Leave it out and every version below this one is treated as exposed.
